Hero_Desc_Aya:
The witch called the Sage of Perpetual Snow.
Aya is one of the few denizens of Elias capable of thinking deeply, leading to many seeking all types of advice from her.
She sometimes says things that cross the line without realizing it.
Album_Like_Aya: Snow. Butterflies. Wide-open spaces under broad skies.
Album_Hate_Aya: Closed spaces such as basements. Hot things.
Album_Hobby_Aya: Making a snowman. Sweeping yards. Drinking iced tea. Taking walks.
Album_Aya1: Aya often gives a cold and composed first impression. However, after a brief talk, it's clear she's just a thoughtful witch, with a warm and caring nature. Aya seems to know this herself, paying extra attention to her actions when meeting someone new.
Album_Aya2: In Elias, where beings who can communicate and act maturely are almost extinct, Aya stands out with her unique presence. She is renowned as the 'Sage of Perpetual Snow' among the elementals of Elemental Mountain, which says it all.
Album_Aya3: I accidentally messed with the flower Aya was carrying because it looked interesting and ended up breaking it. But Aya said it was no big deal and reassured me it was fine. Turns out, the flower-shaped staff Aya carries isn't actually a real staff—it's made of packed snow. After explaining this, Aya used magic to reshape the broken flower back to its original form.
Album_Aya4: Aya says she lives at the summit of Elemental Mountain. She doesn't know why, but the elementals keep her home a secret and protect it. Maybe they mistakenly believe she's a spirit of snow.
Album_Aya5: Whether it's because of her butterfly-shaped hairpin or the flower she always carries, butterflies tend to flock to Aya when she stays still. Under the moonlight, she glows with a soft, white radiance, playing with the butterflies in a way that feels almost otherworldly.
Album_Aya6: Aya enjoys taking walks often, so I frequently run into her while wandering Elias. When I asked why, she told me she lost her younger siblings long ago and now roams in hopes of finding information about them.
Album_Aya7: Wanting to help, I asked about her siblings, but Aya hesitated, saying she wasn't sure whether she should feel happy or sad about their disappearance. When I pressed further, she explained that before they vanished, they would never wake up no matter how hard she tried. She had left, lost in grief, only to return and find them gone. The idea that they might have woken up and left on their own filled her with both hope and despair.
Food_ChefNote_Aya_Hate1: Aya looks flustered that this snow-white food is hot.
Food_ChefNote_Aya_Hate2: Making an inscrutable expression, she said she found the drink confusing, as it was neither cold nor hot.
Food_ChefNote_Aya_Like1: Aya seems more focused on the ice cream's temperature than its taste. She smiles, mumbling the temperature of the ice cream is just right for her.
Food_ChefNote_Aya_Like2: Aya appears to enjoy this polarizing dish. Although it seems the cold was a huge plus for her and why she gave it high such marks...
Food_ChefNote_Aya_Like3: She also thinks this food is easy to eat. She seems interested in mixing it with water to make a beverage.
Food_ChefNote_Aya_Like4: She mentioned eating them frozen feels like eating candy. Her taste in food seems rather unique.
Food_ChefNote_Aya_Like5: After making ice, grinding it up and sprinkling this powder on top she finally ate it. It kinda makes me want to try it too.
Food_ChefNote_Aya_Like6: Aya said the food clearly had a lot of thought put into it and praised the Master as being something entirely different and special.
Food_ChefNote_Aya_Like7: Sometimes you just crave something warm, Aya said. Luckily, she enjoyed what was served.
Food_ChefNote_Aya_Like8: Aya said it's the kind of taste she wants to share one by one with her siblings. She seems to like it.
Food_ChefNote_Aya_Like9: Aya savored the candy slowly, noting a refreshingly cool taste. She plans to freeze the remaining candies.

LoveLetter_Aya: Elemental Mountain's icy peaks can be tranquil, but it can also feel isolating sometimes. Master, I'm always thankful for how seriously you listen to my stories about my search for my siblings and for the genuine care you show.I truly hope we can one day tear down the walls between us and share a true bond. I'll wait for the day your feelings align with mine.
LoveCall_Aya:
Ah, Master... It is good to hear from you. Hm? What happened?
Nothing in particular. I called to tell you that the eternal snow on Elemental Mountain has begun melting little by little.
Do not worry. It is nothing serious, and nothing has happened to the mountain.
It is probably the influence of my emotions.

...Tell me, Master. Do you know what it feels like for snow to melt?
When warmth blossoms within cold that seemed eternal, and sharp edges begin to soften...
The snow slowly lets go of its form and becomes water, able to accept everything.
That is... how I feel now when I think of you.
A corner of my frozen heart is growing warmer...
Even my rigid body seems to be slowly melting in your warmth.
My strange way of speaking has not changed? Well, who can say...?

Oh, you are going to come to Elemental Mountain? No. I would rather you stayed away for a while.
If I saw your face right now, the eternal snow... might melt away completely.
